Female,Ⓒs.ⒹstrI, nArI; See Woman.
Ⓔa.ⒹEx. by the suffixes A, I, or vaDU in comp.; ‘f(emale) sparrow’ cawakA; hariRI, siMhI, cakravAkavaDUH, &c.; ‘f(emale) friend’ vayasyA, saKI, sahacaMrI, Ali f. ‘f(emale) apartments’ avaroDagfhaM, SudDAMtaH, aMtaHpuraM; ‘a f(emale) form’ strIrUpaM, strIsaMsTAnaM; ‘a f(emale) dress’ strI-nepaTyaM-vezaH.

Feminine,Ⓒa.ⒹstrERa (RI f.), strIjAtIya, strI-Tarman.
Ⓑ
 2 ke mala, mfdu, pelava, sukumAra.
Ⓑ
 3 (In gram.) strI; ‘this word is masculine or f(eminine)’ ayaM SabdaH puMsi striyAM vA.
